name: Lunch by the Bag
jem_summary: Consume at least two stored food portions in one use of a Transmutation Lunch Bag.

pages.title: Lunch by the Bag
pages.text: Consume at least two stored food portions in one use of a Transmutation Lunch Bag.

pages.title: Lunch by the Bag
pages.text: Use the bag as a portable supply that fills the hunger bar with several foods in sequence.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Version 1.7.0 stores 24 stacks. One use consumes food in sequence until the hunger bar is full. Arrive hungry enough and load at least two portions. Potions are consumed separately and do not count for this quest.

pages.title: Store kitchen supplies
pages.text: The Enamel Basin stores oil and oils a Kitchen Shovel. A Fruit Basket carries produce; the Lunch Bag consumes its own food in sequence until the hunger bar is full.

pages.title: Eat stored foods in sequence
pages.text: Version 1.7.0 has 24 slots. One use consumes stored foods in sequence until the hunger bar is full. Potions are handled separately; the former sampled bonus-effect behavior is no longer present.
